items.title: Postcomposition with an etale morphism preserves at-worst-nodal morphisms
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file curves.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: Stability lemma (statement 5017-5023, proof 5025-5037): postcomposing an at-worst-nodal morphism by an etale morphism stays at-worst-nodal - the proof combines the standard composition lemmas for flatness and finite presentation with the fibral nature of the definition and the two fibre cases; the smooth-point case is the standard base-change stability of smoothness and is stated without a marker; no step is omitted. H2: short stability argument.
